title: StudyPulse - Student Planner
description: A web application built to help university students track assignments, set study timers using the Pomodoro technique, and manage exam schedules.

title: Algorithmic Visualizer
description: An interactive web utility designed to visualize common sorting algorithms (Bubble Sort, Merge Sort, Quick Sort) in real-time to aid in computer science learning.

title: Campus Marketplace
description: A peer-to-peer marketplace web platform enabling college students to buy, sell, or trade used textbooks and dorm gear securely within campus networks.
